sources.title: natsuiro_matsuri_(1st_costume)
sources.excerpt:
The default costume of [[hololive]]'s [[Natsuiro Matsuri]]. 
 
It consists of a [[crop top|cropped]] [[halterneck]] [[pinstripe camisole|pinstripe]] [[black camisole]] with [[spaghetti strap]]s, a [[green ribbon|green]] [[neck ribbon]], an [[orange jacket|orange]] [[short-sleeved jacket|short-sleeved]] [[off-shoulder jacket|off-shoulder]] [[cropped jacket]] a [[white skirt|white]] [[pleated skirt|pleated]] [[miniskirt]] with a [[side slit]], a [[black pantyhose]] and [[white boots]].
